scenes.name: title
scenes.narration: How Vigil Watchtower stopped a forged batch on the QoreChain testnet.

scenes.name: race
scenes.caption: Without Vigil: final in an hour. With Vigil: stopped in seconds
scenes.narration: Without a watcher, a forged batch is accepted, and an hour later it is final and its fake balances are paid out. With Vigil, the same batch is re-executed, proven wrong, and thrown out within seconds.

scenes.name: catch
scenes.caption: A forged batch, stopped in 5 seconds
scenes.narration: This really happened on the testnet. An attacker bonded a thousand Q O R and posted a forged batch. Two seconds later the watchtower found the wrong state root. Three seconds after that, its fraud proof was confirmed. The chain threw the batch out, and the attacker's bond was slashed.

scenes.name: check
scenes.caption: Re-execute, compare, prove
scenes.narration: The watchtower keeps its own verified copy of the inbox, re-executes every batch, and only sends a challenge after the same check the chain runs confirms the fraud.

scenes.name: alerts
scenes.caption: Raised at once as a critical alert
scenes.narration: The invalid batch and the challenge were raised as critical alerts in the app, and are sent to Telegram or a webhook when one is configured.
